patch_list: Bonjour browser
Lists the Bonjour services announced on the Wi-Fi network, grouped by type, with each service's host, address, port and TXT records.
Common ports list
Adds an editor for the ports the Common port scan checks.
Custom device names
Adds custom names for Wi-Fi networks and LAN devices, shown in the Wi-Fi and LAN lists.
Export results
Adds an export menu to Ping, Traceroute, Port Scan, DNS, Whois, LAN Scan, Wi-Fi Signal and Information, with plain text and CSV output.
External IP details
Adds a Details button to the External IP rows that shows the address's hostname, network operator and location.
Host details
Adds a details page for each ping reply and traceroute hop with its address, hostname, round-trip times, TTL, AS and location.
LAN device details
Adds a details page for each device in the LAN scan with its names, Wake on LAN, Bonjour and UPnP services and web interface, plus text and CSV export of the scan.
LAN scan history
Saves each finished LAN scan and its devices, lets you star, delete or clear saved scans, and scans a custom IP range.
Ping statistics
Adds a bar chart of the current or last ping's round-trip times with min, median, max and lost packets.
Remove ads
Removes the banner ads, the ad consent prompt and the Pro upgrade prompts.
Settings
Adds a Settings screen with the theme, Wi-Fi scan frequency and 6 GHz scan options.
Speed test
Adds an internet speed test with download and upload charts and a test history.
Tool options
Adds ping protocol, TCP ping, probe delay, payload size, don't fragment and audible ping, traceroute and port scan delays, whois and RDAP servers, and DNS flags.
Tools history
Lists the hosts queried in Tools with their last options, and lets you star or delete them. Tapping an entry opens it in Tools.
UPnP browser
Lists the UPnP devices on the Wi-Fi network with their model, manufacturer, embedded devices and services.
Visual traceroute
Shows the hops of the current or last traceroute on an OpenStreetMap map. Map tiles load from tile.openstreetmap.org.
Wi-Fi channel usage
Adds a chart of how busy each Wi-Fi channel is, stacking the networks that share it.
Wi-Fi network details
Adds a details page for each network in the Signal list with its channel range, utilization, beamforming support, maximum speed and modulation.
